UPDATE ethereum_111k_control SET paused = 1, revision = revision + 1,
    paused_at_ms = (CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000),
    chain_id = 11155111, contract_address = '0xef5ffe06eb0d94a575656eb6ffcd97b8e2121b1c', updated_at_ms = (CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000)
    WHERE singleton = 1 AND revision = 31 AND reset_guard_id IS NULL
      AND paused = 0
      AND chain_id IS 11155111 AND contract_address IS '0xef5ffe06eb0d94a575656eb6ffcd97b8e2121b1c'
       RETURNING *
